guardReason: Opens, comments on and closes the golden and capture issues, and dispatches the dispatch-only baseline workflows, with gh; meant to run only from main-red-alert.yml.
description: Keeps two GitHub issues in step with main's macOS goldens and capture render (push and nightly runs): 'Golden or capture failure', labelled release-block:mobile so Release Readiness fails while it is open, when either job failed; and the report-only 'Golden baselines drifted', which dispatches the drifted suite's baseline workflow at that commit for a person to review and commit. No auto-revert.
